column4: motion prompt (image-to-video from the still; keep the scratchboard medium, white lines on black, no colour, the face never shown)
Slow pull back and down. The campfire flickers, his two long shadows sway across the ground while he stands still, the wolfdog's ears twitch, sparks drift up. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
Static camera, slight push in. The flames lean and reach toward him, his shadows stretch to the right, the duster's shredded hem stirs in the wind. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
High crane drifting slowly. Rings of light ripple outward from the fire across the plain, one after another; he stands still by the fire. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.

Low angle, slow arc. He strums the Les Paul and rocks with the beat, head tipped toward the neck, the string veil sways; smoke ribbons rise and curl from the fire. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
Locked-off wide. The stars slowly wheel across the sky, a shooting star streaks across, the tiny fire flickers. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
The fire flares up and the smoke serpent rises out of it, coils, and turns its glowing head toward him. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.

Slow push in on the veiled head as he sings: the head moves with the phrasing, the strings of the veil sway, his hair stirs; the serpent's head breathes smoke over his shoulder. Never show a face. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
The smoke serpent arches over him and breathes a cloud of smoke down over his hat; his duster blows back. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
Ground-level, slow track. Rivers of smoke pour across the plain and flow past him; the fire flickers behind. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
The sky catches fire from the horizon upward; the camera cranes up with the front of the flames; he stands still, his coat blowing. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
Slow tilt up. The glyph constellations brighten one by one, their stars twinkling; he looks up at them, hair and hem stirring. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
Storm clouds roll in fast and break the burning sky apart; rain sweeps across; lightning flickers. Scratchboard engraving, white on black.
